references.text: God forbids Noah from eating meat with blood in it, which is the first biblical commandment against consuming blood
An eternal statute prohibiting the consumption of fat and blood, reaffirming the ban on drinking blood
The prohibition against eating blood from birds or animals, with the threat of being cut off from the people
A detailed law regarding the ban on consuming blood, explaining that the blood is the seat of life
Reiterates the prohibition against eating blood and instructs to pour it out on the ground like water
Reminder not to eat the blood but to pour it out on the ground like water
Saul warns the people against sinning by eating meat with blood in it
The Apostolic Council in Jerusalem requires Gentile Christians to abstain from blood
Confirms the ban on consuming blood as part of the necessary requirements for Gentile Christians
